about_the_game:
THE POLICE CODE FOR “ASSAULT WITH THE INTENT TO MURDER”

          “217” A Psychological Survival Thriller is a hyper-realistic “Survival Simulation” set in a remote part of the expansive 2.8 million square miles of forest in North America.

          Descend into the depths of unimaginable terror in this edge of your seat, adrenaline packed thrill ride. As the latest target of two psychopathic, professional human traffickers, you must outsmart your captors to stand a chance at surviving the next 12 hours.

The incessant “Foot on your neck” barrage of terror will have you white knuckling your controller to the very end.

           After being assaulted and rendered unconscious during a home invasion, you regain consciousness to find yourself bound and gagged, in the backseat of a moving car…

                          The immediate decisions you make next are LIFE or DEATH

    Unlike any other “horror" or "Survival" game. The cinematic visuals and immersive storyline put you in the center of a terrifying, interactive, movie-like experience.

                      NO ZOMBIES, NO GUNS, NO MAGIC POWERS, NO ONE TO HELP…

             As a “Survival Simulation” there are no “one-ups”, extra-lives or magic healing herbs. You don’t have the luxury of military grade guns or sci-fi weapons from another dimension. There are NO special abilities or ammunition pick-ups. You MUST be cunning, utilizing your environment to outwit and stay one step ahead.

             “217” A Psychological Survival Thriller deploys the latest technology in gaming, in harmony with cinematic principles and techniques from Film and Television. We leverage the power of digital scanning and photogrammetry to digitally capture real world assets to use in-game.

content_descriptors.notes: This game depicts scenes of graphic violence and gore. Viewer discretion is advised

detailed_description:
CONTAINS SCENES OF GRAPHIC VIOLENCE AND ADULT SITUATIONS, PLAYER DISCRETION IS ADVISED

This game contains Graphic Violence, Gore, Foul Language, Adult Themes, Flashing Lights and Anxiety inducing Stress. Not suitable for children, people with heart conditions or those who are pregnant. PLAYER DISCRETION IS ADVISED


EXPERIENCE 217 AT MDEV2025

Be one of the first to experience "217 A Psychological Survival Thriller" LIVE at MDEV2025 in Madison Wisconsin on November 7th and 8th at the Alliant Energy Center.
